name: mason
description: Context engineering MCP server — concept maps for codebases so LLMs stop re-exploring every session.
long_description: Mason persists a feature-to-file concept map in `.mason/snapshot.json` so AI assistants can answer architecture questions without grepping the codebase from scratch. Also exposes change impact analysis (co-change history, references, related tests) and git history aggregation (hot files, stale dirs, commit patterns).

tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: Load the concept map — maps features and flows to files.

tools.name: save_snapshot
tools.description: Persist the concept map for future sessions.

tools.name: get_impact
tools.description: Change impact analysis: co-change history, references, related tests.

tools.name: analyze_project
tools.description: Git history aggregation: commit patterns, hot files, stale dirs.

tools.name: full_analysis
tools.description: All-in-one first visit: git stats, structure, code samples, test map.

tools.name: get_code_samples
tools.description: Smart file previews selected by architectural role.
